name: Awoken Requiem of the Goddess (Dual Shift)
effects:
Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Smart Ether 3] & Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode II to the user, removes Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode I
Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode II: When status is removed, grants [ATK +80%] & chases Lightning/Holy abilities with 10 single-target Lightning/Holy/NE physical attacks (0.28 each) for 8 seconds
